# Armin Salon & Rejuvenation Center

> Armin Salon & Rejuvenation Center is a full-service South Miami salon and day spa at 5910 SW 73rd Street, South Miami, Florida — hair, colour, skin, nails, and occasions under one roof, minutes from Coral Gables and Coconut Grove. To reserve, call (305) 663-7171.

## About
- Business: Armin Salon & Rejuvenation Center (hair salon and day spa)
- Address: 5910 SW 73rd Street, South Miami, FL 33143, USA
- Phone: (305) 663-7171
- Website: https://arminsalonspamiami.com/
- Areas served: South Miami, Coral Gables, Coconut Grove, Pinecrest, Kendall
- Operations: run day to day by Lazaro, Operations Director

## Hours
- Tuesday, Wednesday, Saturday: 9:00 AM – 7:00 PM
- Thursday, Friday: 9:00 AM – 8:00 PM
- Sunday, Monday: by appointment only

## Services
- Hair: cuts, blowouts, styling
- Colour: balayage, face-framing highlights, blonde refresh, gloss
- Skin & Spa: facials, waxing, skin treatments
- Nails: acrylic, dip powder, manicures, pedicures
- Occasions: makeup, bridal parties, event styling
- Products: professional keratin and hair-care lines
- Note: the salon does not offer massage.
